services.title: Stakeholder Mapping
services.description: Identify key stakeholders, clarify goals, and align decision-makers through structured mapping and facilitated workshops.

services.title: Participatory Research
services.description: Engage users and domain experts directly to uncover needs, motivations, and constraints through hands-on research methods.

services.title: Persona & Journey Design
services.description: Translate research insights into actionable personas and journey maps that guide design and product decisions.

services.title: Empathy Workshops
services.description: Build shared understanding across teams by immersing stakeholders in user perspectives and real-world scenarios.

services.title: Problem & Opportunity Analysis
services.description: Frame complex challenges clearly by identifying root causes, opportunities, and measurable success criteria.

services.title: Co-creation & Ideation
services.description: Facilitate structured ideation sessions that turn insights into concepts collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.

services.title: Strategy Design
services.description: Define clear design and product strategies that connect business objectives with user needs and technical feasibility.

services.title: Living Labs & Pilot Projects
services.description: Validate ideas in real contexts through pilots and experiments before scaling into full-fledged solutions.
